baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ directs movement toward Q-D-R as an endpoint qualified by ʿ-L-M.
baseline_models.mechanism: Q-D-R supplies an extent that reaches its limit, while ʿ-L-M makes that extent cognitively determinate; together they form a bounded rather than open-ended terminus.

activation_trace.role: Measured extent supplies the bounded content of the endpoint selected by إِلَىٰ.
Clear knowing makes the measured endpoint determinate rather than indefinite.

changed_reading.before: The phrase merely says 'until a known time.'
changed_reading.after: The phrase depicts approach to a measured extent whose limiting point is already determinate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَّعْلُومٍ can activate the ʿ-L-M image of a distinguishing mark while قَدَرٍ supplies the bounded extent.
baseline_models.mechanism: A limit becomes usable as an endpoint when it is not only known but marked: the measure supplies the boundary and the mark supplies orientation toward it.

activation_trace.role: Measured extent provides the threshold's bounded side.
A distinguishing mark makes the threshold identifiable and orienting.

changed_reading.before: Knownness is only information possessed by a knower.
changed_reading.after: The endpoint is also a marked threshold toward which the process can be oriented.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَدَرٍ can draw on Q-D-R's planning branch, and مَّعْلُومٍ qualifies the resulting specification.
baseline_models.mechanism: The endpoint may be a specification produced by estimate and deliberation rather than a date that simply exists; its knownness concerns defined parameters.

activation_trace.role: Deliberative arrangement turns the endpoint into a specification with prepared parameters.
Clear knowing makes those prepared parameters determinate.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint is a passively given deadline.
changed_reading.after: The endpoint is a known specification arrived at through proportioning and deliberation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence supplies reproductive fluid, measured creation, imposed state, stable containment, and a locus of being. These cues revise the focus limit from a bare date into the completion criterion of a calibrated developmental process in protected containment.

activation_trace.role: Measured extent anchors the developmental process to a bounded completion point.
Determinate knowing makes the completion criterion specified rather than accidental.
Creation as measuring supplies calibration at the process's beginning.
Reproductive fluid in the womb supplies the material undergoing development.
Causing a thing to assume a state supplies the transition into protected placement.
Stability supplies sustained containment during the measured interval.
A locus of being supplies the spatial condition in which the calibrated process can run.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 forms one sequence: creation from fluid, placement in a secure locus, movement toward the focus endpoint, then renewed Q-D-R predication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the material, calibrated creation, imposed placement, stability, and locus; I infer that their sequence makes Q-D-R a developmental completion criterion. A live alternative is that the phrase marks elapsed gestational time only.

changed_reading.before: A known duration passes while material is stored.
changed_reading.after: A measured developmental run proceeds under stable containment until its specified completion criterion is reached.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate recurrence of Q-D-R as an act and an agent description converts the focus noun from a static measure into an enacted proportion backed by effective capacity.

activation_trace.role: Deliberative arrangement anchors the focus endpoint as a prepared specification.
Determinate knowing fixes the specification's parameters.
The repeated root's planning branch turns measured specification into an expressly performed arrangement.
Effective capacity supplies the power that secures the planned measure in action.

structural_cues: 77:23 immediately follows the focus and repeats Q-D-R as both an act and an agent description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate root recurrence plus planning and capacity branches; I read the later predication backward as identifying agency behind the focus measure. Alternatively, 77:23 may praise general power without narrowing the noun in 77:22.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint is a pre-existing known specification.
changed_reading.after: The endpoint is actively proportioned and made effective by the capacity of its arranger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promise bounded by an appointment, explicit timing, and a fixed terminal period form a sequence of scheduled realization. The focus measure becomes a local instance of the surah's larger architecture of appointed outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Measured extent anchors the local process to a terminal bound.
Known determinacy makes that local bound an appointment rather than an uncertain end.
An appointment bounded by time or place supplies the promise-to-realization frame.
Defining by a time or goal supplies explicit scheduling.
A fixed terminal period supplies the deadline toward which delay moves.

structural_cues: 77:7, 77:11, and 77:12 advance from promised occurrence to timing and a deferred terminal date.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, timing, and terminal-period images; I infer that the same scheduling logic nests the biological endpoint inside a surah-wide sequence. The live alternative is that the early deadline and the focus term remain parallel but independent examples.

changed_reading.before: The known measure is confined to one biological interval.
changed_reading.after: The biological interval exemplifies a broader order in which processes are assigned determinate moments of realization.

context_deltas.mechanism: A child-separation branch, reproductive material, stable containment, and both release and labor images make the focus limit function as a gate: the measured process ends by separating what was contained and releasing it into a new state.

activation_trace.role: Measured extent supplies the threshold at which containment ends.
A distinguishing mark makes the release threshold identifiable.
Separation of a child from mother or nursing supplies the embodied boundary-crossing image.
Reproductive fluid in the womb identifies what enters the contained process.
Stability supplies the state from which release eventually occurs.
Release from a bond supplies outward motion beyond containment.
The labor-pain branch makes that outward transition specifically birth-like.

structural_cues: The incubation sequence at 77:20-23 is framed elsewhere by repeated separation language and later commands of release or motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies womb material, stable placement, child-separation, release, and labor images; I infer that the known measure is the gate coordinating their transition. A live alternative keeps F-S-L judicial and Ṭ-L-Q imperative, making the birth linkage only a distant resonance.

changed_reading.before: The known measure is the amount of time spent inside containment.
changed_reading.after: The known measure is the marked release threshold at which contained development becomes separation and entry into a new state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth's gathering into a receptacle is immediately specified across living and dead states. Read back through the focus's bounded, marked endpoint, this creates a handoff model: one container's measured term opens into another containing order spanning life and death.

activation_trace.role: Measured extent supplies the boundary governing transfer from one state to the next.
A distinguishing mark supplies the identifiable handoff point.
Gathering and holding in a receptacle extends containment from the secure locus to the earth.
Animate life supplies one state held by the encompassing receptacle.
Loss of life supplies the opposed state gathered by the same receptacle.

structural_cues: 77:25-26 immediately reframe the earth as a gatherer of living and dead after the womb sequence closes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a second receptacle plus living/dead polarity; I infer a transfer relation between the womb's term and the earth's encompassing function. The alternative is that the two containers are independent demonstrations with no handoff implied.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint only closes an internal prenatal interval.
changed_reading.after: The endpoint regulates a transfer between containing states, placing prenatal development inside a larger life-to-death containment cycle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognition by a trace, erasure of a trace, repeated contradiction of truth, and final manifestation turn مَّعْلُومٍ from private knownness into evidentiary markedness. The endpoint belongs to a sign process whose markers can be denied or erased without changing its measure.

activation_trace.role: Measured extent anchors the sign process to an objective boundary.
A distinguishing mark gives knownness an observable, orienting form.
Recognition after an effect or sign supplies the act by which a marked boundary is read.
Erasure of a trace supplies the reversal in which prior markers disappear at realization.
Contradiction of truth supplies the social refusal to accept what the marks disclose.
Bringing something forth and showing it supplies final manifestation after disputed signs.

structural_cues: The surah moves from recognizable or erasable signs through a repeated denial refrain and closes by asking what later discourse could ground trust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognition, mark-erasure, denial, and manifestation; I infer that their sequence externalizes the focus's knownness as evidence. A live alternative restricts مَّعْلُومٍ to knowledge of the arranger with no public marker implied.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint is known only because a knower has its date.
changed_reading.after: The endpoint is an objectively measured and sign-bearing threshold whose denial does not unset its arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later enjoyment is described through extension to a limit and littleness. Those cues activate Q-D-R's measured and constricted branches, making the focus term a prototype for bounded allotment rather than a value-neutral duration.

activation_trace.role: Measured extent supplies the finite allotment.
Narrowing to a scant measure supplies the allotment's restricted character.
Determinate knowing fixes the restricted allotment's end.
Extension that reaches its limit supplies the temporary span of enjoyment.
Littleness supplies the span's deliberately scant scale.

structural_cues: 77:46 joins enjoyment and littleness in one imperative immediately before another denial refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limited extension and littleness; I map that later allotment back to Q-D-R's measured and constricted possibilities. Alternatively, the focus measure remains prenatal while 77:46 independently limits worldly enjoyment.

changed_reading.before: The known measure is a neutral biological duration.
changed_reading.after: The phrase also models allotted duration as finite and potentially scant: a determined reprieve rather than open possession of time.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates Q-D-R's cooking-vessel branch and two form-distant vessel branches in neighboring roots. It remains anchored in قَدَرٍ and coheres with the explicit stable-containment sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a material vessel resonance, never as a lexical replacement for 'measure.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَدَرٍ itself carries a packet branch for a cooking vessel, while إِلَىٰ still requires that the vessel resonance serve the measured endpoint.

activation_trace.role: The cooking-vessel branch supplies a material container in which contents mature toward readiness.
A cloth used to lower a pot supplies handling and placement of the imagined vessel.
Pouring into a container supplies the transfer of material into stable holding.
A small pot supplies a second vessel image after the focus sequence.

changed_reading.before: The phrase names only a deadline imposed on contained material.
changed_reading.after: The measured-term phrase also carries a contained-maturation resonance: material is held as in a vessel until its prepared limit is reached.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the decisive context citation uses the packet's non-dominant W-S-M mapping under the sky root and joins it to stellar prominence and trace-erasure. It remains validly anchored in ʿ-L-M's mark branch with fully resolvable packet citations; downstream prose should call it a cosmic sign-system resonance, not equate the sky word with 'mark.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَّعْلُومٍ activates ʿ-L-M's distinguishing-mark branch, allowing the measured endpoint to be tested against context images of prominent and erased markers.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark anchors knownness in an observable sign.
A prominent sign supplies the cosmic marker that can orient recognition.
Erasure of a trace supplies the collapse of the prior marker system at the boundary.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies a visible mark by which a thing becomes known.

changed_reading.before: The known endpoint is an invisible item of knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The endpoint can resonate as a marked cosmic threshold whose realization includes erasure of the former orienting signs.

strongest_changes: The immediate fluid-placement sequence turns a bare deadline into a calibrated developmental completion criterion inside stable containment.
The Q-D-R recurrence in 77:23 makes the measure enacted and capacity-backed rather than merely static.
Appointment, terminal-period, and limited-enjoyment cues widen the focus into a general pattern of determined and bounded allotments.
Separation and earth-as-receptacle cues keep a transfer model live in which the endpoint coordinates movement between containing states.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package let remote timing, separation, denial, and scant-enjoyment sequences alter a three-word focus phrase, while the branch inventories preserved odd but coherent vessel and non-dominant cosmic-mark activations that a conservative synthesis would likely drop.
remaining_uncertainties: Q-D-R may foreground measured extent, deliberate specification, effective capacity, or constricted allotment; the packet supports coexistence but does not force one branch.
The ʿ-L-M qualifier may denote knowledge held by the arranger, an externally marked threshold, or both.
The release, container-handoff, vessel, and cosmic-mark models are anchored resonances rather than syntax-required translations.
